## Purpose

Give the issue number.
State the problem in one or two short sentences.

Related issue: #

## Change

State what you changed.
Use one term for one concept.
Do not change API names to make an editorial change.

## Tests

Give the commands that you ran.
Give the results.
Name the browsers or operating systems that you tested.
State which tests did not run.

## Risk and rollback

State the important risks.
Tell the reviewer how to reverse the change.

## Controlled-English review

- [ ] I used the terms in [the glossary](../docs/glossary.md).
- [ ] I used short sentences and direct instructions.
- [ ] I checked the meaning of source links, numbers, and units.
- [ ] I did not change the spelling of code, paths, commands, or test output.
- [ ] I recorded the review state as **STE-aligned draft** or added evidence of a full ASD-STE100 check.

See [MADR 0003](../docs/adr/0003-use-asd-ste100-for-communication.md).
